description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Sly Requisitioner triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
